annotations.title: Query Dark Fiber and Telecom Routes

description: Finds long-haul and metro dark fiber routes, telecom carrier diversity, and distance to internet exchange points near a project or location. Pass a project name, city, or coordinates.

latitude.description: Site latitude in decimal degrees WGS84 (e.g. 39.0438).

limit.description: Maximum number of fiber route records to return.

location.description: City, county, or market location (e.g. 'Ashburn, VA', 'Columbus, OH').

longitude.description: Site longitude in decimal degrees WGS84 (e.g. -77.4874).

project.description: Project name, alias, canonical project ID, Map project ID, queue ID, or developer plus place (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Hyperion', 'AXP-US-LA-00003', 'QTS Atlanta').

project_id.description: Optional project ID to query dark fiber routes near the project (e.g. 'P017').

project_name.description: Optional project name to center the fiber search on (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene').

query.description: Location or project query for dark fiber and carrier diversity (e.g. 'Ashburn, VA').

radius_miles.description: Search radius in miles around target coordinates (default: 20).

site.description: Project name, site name, city, county, or canonical ID (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Columbus, OH', 'Loudoun County, VA').

name: query_telecom_and_dark_fiber

next_useful_tools.description: Suggested follow-up MCP tools relevant to this result.

status.description: Execution status (OK, SUCCESS, RESOLVED, AMBIGUOUS_ENTITY, NOT_FOUND, ERROR).

using_project.description: Banner confirming the resolved project name, city, state, and canonical ID when a project was matched.
